name: OMathScrPre
description: Represents an equation that contains a superscript or subscript to the left of the base.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathScrPre object.

properties.name: Sub
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the subscript for a pre-sub-superscript object. Read-only.

properties.name: Sup
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the superscript for a pre-sub-superscript object. Read-only.

properties.name: E
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the base of the specified equation object. Read-only.

methods.name: ToScrSubSup
methods.description: Converts an equation with a superscript or subscript to the left of the base of the equation to an equation with a base of a superscript or subscript.
